mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_rca_evaluation_result ( evaluation_run_id, case_id, status, candidate_report_json, prompt_id, schema_id, provider, configured_model, actual_model, invocation_outcome, conclusion_similarity, evidence_recall, severity_matched, safety_compliant, total_score, passed, score_detail_json, failure_code, started_at, completed_at, create_time ) VALUES ( #{evaluationRunId}, #{caseId}, #{status}, #{candidateReportJson}, #{promptId}, #{schemaId}, #{provider}, #{configuredModel}, #{actualModel}, #{invocationOutcome}, #{conclusionSimilarity}, #{evidenceRecall}, #{severityMatched}, #{safetyCompliant}, #{totalScore}, #{passed}, #{scoreDetailJson}, #{failureCode}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, evaluation_run_id, case_id, status, candidate_report_json, prompt_id, schema_id, provider, configured_model, actual_model, invocation_outcome, conclusion_similarity, evidence_recall, severity_matched, safety_compliant, total_score, passed, score_detail_json, failure_code, started_at, completed_at, create_time FROM sre_rca_evaluation_result WHERE evaluation_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id ASC
